pattern_explanation: Both English and Ukrainian borrowed the root of this word from the same old source meaning storehouse. Over time the English word came to mean a printed periodical, while the Ukrainian word kept the meaning of a shop.
false_friend_warning: The Ukrainian word 'mahazyn' looks very similar to the English word 'magazine', but it means shop or store, not a printed periodical. Students should match it with 'shop', not 'magazine'.
